question: What will be the water level of the Great Salt Lake on December 31, 2026?

calls.reasoning: USGS 10010000 is at 4190.3 ft (daily mean Nov 21-23 2026, 15-min readings 4190.2-4190.3 on Nov 24), up ~0.6 ft from the early-Oct low of ~4189.7. Nov23->Dec31 daily-mean changes 2021-2025 were +0.1, +0.4, +0.2, +0.3, +0.2 (median +0.2); 2022, the most similar low-lake year, gained +0.4. This autumn's rise has been brisk, so I take a median of +0.25 ft, giving ~4190.55. Resolution is a single 15-min reading, so wind setup adds roughly ±0.2-0.4 ft of noise, skewed upward. Above 4191.05 needs a +0.75 ft rise (~3%). No market prices the Dec 31 level; Polymarket's lowest-2026 market (4189.3-4189.4 at 97%) is a different contract but matches this gauge's 2026 lowest daily mean of 4189.4.

calls.reasoning: Current USGS 10010000 IV readings 4190.2-4190.3 ft (Nov 24). Reference class: Nov24->Dec31 change in 8 prior years (2018-2025) was always positive: +0.3,+0.5,+0.1,+0.2,+0.4,+0.2,+0.3,+0.2 (median +0.25). Implies Dec 31 ~4190.5-4190.6. Resolution uses a single 15-min instantaneous reading (~4:45pm MST), and wind seiche spikes of +/-1 ft were seen this month, so tail mass above 4191.05 (~6%). No matching human market: Polymarket markets are on the 2026 minimum (priced 97% on 4189.3-4189.4, consistent with the Oct 10 daily low of 4189.4); Manifold markets are about 2030.
calls.reference_class: Great Salt Lake (Saltair gauge) late-Nov to Dec-31 level change, 2018-2025

calls.reasoning: USGS 10010000 reads ~4190.3 ft (daily 4190.3 Nov 21-23; 15-min values 4190.2-4190.3 on Nov 24). Reference class: Nov 23 -> Dec 31 change in 2018-2025, always positive, +0.1 to +0.5 ft (mean +0.28). This fall is unusually wet (record October rain, saturated soils, Nov storms, Oct Pineview release) and the lake rose ~0.5 ft since Oct 31, so I center on +0.3-0.35 ft, giving a median of ~4190.6. The resolving value is likely a single instantaneous reading, which adds ~0.1 ft noise plus a small chance of a wind spike (Nov 19-20 saw readings up to 4191.7), priced as ~4% above 4191.05. No human market matches this contract: the Polymarket contracts are on the lowest 2026 elevation and the Manifold ones are about 2030.
calls.reference_class: Great Salt Lake (USGS 10010000) elevation change from Nov 23 to Dec 31, years 2018-2025
